frontend-suite.description: Everything for frontend work in one install — semantic markup, accessibility, React/Next/TypeScript, Tailwind tokens + design system, design quality, SEO, Storybook, SVGs, cookie consent, branding/copy, structure, naming, and the repo's CI/CD.

audits-suite.description: The review mirror of the frontend suite — one manually-invoked audit per domain, each self-contained and each writing a scored, prioritised report. `audit-all` runs every applicable one and aggregates them.

frontend-and-audits.description: Both suites in one install — the standards to build against and the audits to review the result.
